sessions.boundary_reason: The ClauseCal-v1 audit concludes; discussion shifts to a separate hazard-score hypothesis.

sessions.boundary_reason: Hazard recall falls below the proposed threshold; the next stage integrates late-cue forecasts.

sessions.boundary_reason: Lattice-only gating advances, while the initial lead-ins are deferred for insufficient grammaticality.

sessions.topic: Validate and adopt stall lead-ins on held-out speakers
sessions.boundary_reason: The held-out audit supports adoption; discussion shifts to counterfactual encoder training.

sessions.boundary_reason: SwapEnc-v1 is adopted on the initial comparison; the next test examines component contributions.
The ablation is reported; discussion shifts to possible overfitting on natural late cues.

sessions.boundary_reason: Natural late-cue results lead to deferring SwapEnc-v1; discussion returns to validating the retained system.
